title: Ask your assistant about your records
one_line: Let your coding assistant search, explain and verify your recorded decisions.
verified_against: Every tool called through an in-process MCP client session with mcp 2.3.0 and mcp 1.30.0, over receiver records built from the captured Claude Code 2.1.330 payload. Not run inside a real assistant. Local files only: the platform read API needs a browser session and is not queried.
